name: RTIEBT, Regras Técnicas das Instalações Eléctricas de Baixa Tensão (Portugal)
references: Portugal's Regras Técnicas das Instalações Eléctricas de Baixa Tensão (RTIEBT, Portaria 949-A/2006, Diário da República 1.ª série no. 175, 1st supplement, 11/09/2006), section 803.2.4.3
note: A building's demand by this country's method (`building_demand`). The rest of the discipline comes from BIMCraft's library, and says so.

building_demand.source: Portugal's Regras Técnicas das Instalações Eléctricas de Baixa Tensão (RTIEBT, Portaria 949-A/2006, Diário da República 1.ª série no. 175, 1st supplement, 11/09/2006), section 803.2.4.3: the power of the collective installations and entries of a building is the sum of the installations' powers times a simultaneity factor by their number downstream. E-REDES's connection manual (9th edition, 2018, Quadro 2.3) takes the same factors.

dwelling.source: RTIEBT 801.5.2.2 and 803.2.4.3.1 a) (p. 6682-(163) and (185)): a dwelling's least power by its number of rooms, single-phase at 230 V

grades.name: 1 room
grades.source: RTIEBT 801.5.2.2: one room, 3.45 kVA (15 A at 230 V)

grades.name: 2-6 rooms
grades.source: RTIEBT 801.5.2.2: two to six rooms, 6.90 kVA (30 A)

grades.name: 7+ rooms
grades.source: RTIEBT 801.5.2.2: more than six rooms, 10.35 kVA (45 A)

diversity.source: RTIEBT Quadro 803A (p. 6682-(185)), called by 803.2.4.3.2 a) and 803.4.6.6: the simultaneity factor for dwellings and their annexes by the number of installations downstream, 1.00 for 2 to 4 and 0.34 from 50

notes: A dwelling's power is the one its project gives, never under its grade (803.2.4.3.1 a)); a dwelling three-phase only for three-phase equipment takes 10.35 kVA at least.
Annexes take 3.45 kVA (803.2.4.3.1 b)) and count as installations downstream: give them as a group with their `demand`, so that they are weighted with the dwellings.
Installations other than dwellings (shops, the common services) take the designer's factor, 1 without one (803.2.4.3.2 b)): give them in `commercial` or `common_demand`.
not_covered: the conductors, protections and voltage drops of the risers and entries (803.4)
the connection to the network: E-REDES's DIT-C14-100 (portinhola, branch cables and fuses)
electric vehicle charging (Portaria 128/2026/1: 3 680 VA a point, its number by the parking spaces)
